scope: Generic recording/segment provenance, development-recording selection stability, and separately matched observation budgets

selection.models: all 42 previously fitted candidates plus hold/trend; no new tuning or weights
policies: minimax ratio to hold over records/horizons/output groups
equal-record MSE subject to <=1.05 times hold RMSE in every development recording/horizon/group, else hold
selection.ratio_floor: 1e-12 in mean squared standardized group error
selection.validation: choose on all development records, and leave one development recording out then score it; original evaluation recordings kept separate
selection.diagnostics: per output/horizon reference-relative RMSE, empirical guard violations, selection changes, gain versus hold; no test-driven policy changes

coverage.source: Crazyflie log10 training; same log15/log16 longest-interval development/evaluation as prior frozen sensor experiment
coverage.policy: allocate exactly 337 state rows as evenly as possible across ten eligible powered intervals, one contiguous crop per interval with deterministic random starts; all complete windows; repeat seeds60/61/62
coverage.models: same six representations x six ridge fractions plus recursive x six
coverage.comparisons: original337unique-row/320window fit; previous1721unique-row/320window adaptive fit; new337unique-row/<320window segmented fits
coverage.limits: fixed unique-row and fixed-window comparisons answer different questions; no attempt to equate both when geometrically impossible

limits: All these recordings have been inspected in earlier work. No new untouched evaluation recording is claimed.
X8 records are maneuver segments from one campaign, not independent platforms or necessarily independent sorties.
Future logged commands condition forecasts; no controller or trajectory behavior changes.
Empirical development guards are not statistical guarantees or calibrated uncertainty.
No airframe equations or platform-specific learner features.
